manifest.name: v1-bias-ridge-gated
manifest.description: V1 baseline + per-platform-gated ridge residual learner. Lightning and Mach-E: V1 unchanged (per-route-CV showed no strict-Pareto improvement). IONIQ-5: V1 + 7-feature ridge (lambda=10000) residual head (strict Pareto win on yaw and CTE). Tesla: V0 passthrough.
manifest.notes: Uses only the 8 allowlist input columns. Coefficients in coeffs.json. CV: 5-fold route-grouped.
